Look

Colour paints the world: bark, moss, earth and kit. Black and white is the original grey look.

Kill streaks: the numbers, bzings and tier names. Quiet keeps the counter and sound without the big words and glow. Off hides it all; streaks still pay.

Trial

Searchers: the woods stay empty until a searcher's beam finds you, then the swarm comes until you're back inside the fence. Classic brings back the old hunters.

Boss weapons: beat a boss and take its weapon, carry two and swap between them. So far: the Woodcutter's Felling Axe. Off: the torch only, as before.

Leaderboard

    How to play

    ExpeditionLoot, camp, orbs

    Live in a walled camp and head out for loot. Carry it home to bank it and buy upgrades that last. Your torch burns oil and loot weighs you down. The further out, the worse it gets. Three green orbs wait in the deep; bring them home to the shrine. Die out there and you lose what you carried.

    WispsSpent at the camp shop

    Everything you burn in Nightfall and Expedition leaves a violet wisp. Grab it before it fades, then spend wisps at the shop by the camp fire on upgrades that last. In Expedition, wisps only count once you carry them home. Stats on the title menu keeps your record: distance walked, enemies burned, bosses felled and more.

    NightfallWaves, upgrades

    Shades only move in the dark and freeze in your light. Hold the beam on them and they burn. Burn every shade to reach dawn, then pick an upgrade. Each wave brings more, and new kinds.

    ChaseSearch, then run

    Stop to search with a fading torch, then run blind for eight seconds while they flee. Two red trails show where they went. Miss them once and they're gone.

    BlinkNo running

    Two seconds of dark, then the torch comes on somewhere new with them hidden nearby. Find them before the light fades.

    Free roamNo goals

    Walk the woods with rabbits, birds and fireflies.

    PhoneRight thumb aims. Left thumb runs. Tap Attack to swing the torch (tap again to chain three hits). Tap Dodge to roll. Tap Shop at the fire to spend embers and wisps. DesktopMouse aims
    W or Space runs
    Left-click or J attacks (three in a row chain, attack out of a roll to lunge)
    Right-click or Q dodges
    F switches the torch (not in Expedition)
    R toggles auto run
    E opens the shop at the fire
    G lights a recall flare, T plants a lantern     ControllerLeft stick runs, right stick aims
    A or RT attacks, B dodges
    X uses, Y is your weapon's special
    LB and RB change what's in your hand (Expedition: LB swaps weapon)
    D-pad: up or LT drinks a flask, down lights a recall flare, left plants a lantern, right toggles auto run
    View opens the pack, Menu pauses
    In menus, the d-pad or left stick moves, A presses, B goes back

    Stats

    Burn things, grab the wisps they leave, spend them here. Stats last for good, in Nightfall and Expedition.
